title: Zero Trust Identity Dashboard
description: Full-stack identity verification system implementing Zero Trust architecture with JWT authentication, role-based access control, contextual policy evaluation, and persistent audit logging.

title: AI-Powered Threat Detection Engine
description: Machine learning anomaly detection engine that ingests Apache error logs and OpenSSH auth logs, extracts behavioral features, and surfaces alerts with human-readable reasons using an Isolation Forest model.

title: DevSecOps Pipeline Scanner
description: Multi-language dependency vulnerability scanner and secret detector. Queries OSV.dev for CVEs across PyPI, npm, Go, and Rust ecosystems. Integrates with GitHub Actions for automated CI/CD security gating.

title: Cloud Misconfiguration Auditor
description: Audits AWS resources against CIS Benchmark rules using LocalStack. Checks S3, IAM, and Security Groups for misconfigurations including open buckets, weak password policies, and unrestricted inbound traffic.

title: Incident Response Runbook Simulator
description: Decision-based incident response training tool with phishing and ransomware scenarios mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Scores analyst decisions and generates graded post-incident reports.

title: COVSAW — Static Analysis Tool
description: Custom static analysis tool for automated Python security verification, built as part of undergraduate thesis research. Benchmarked against Semgrep and Bandit on a 200-file corpus. Accompanied by SafeCrypto, an interactive web platform for CWE-based secure coding education.

title: Agri-Coop
description: Cooperative agricultural management platform built in Java. Covers resource allocation, member management, and cooperative operations. Demonstrates object-oriented design and full application architecture.

title: LEO Satellite IoT Authentication Protocol
description: High-performance authentication framework for LEO satellite-to-ground communication. Optimised C-based protocol logic achieving a 1,807x improvement in key generation speed over RSA-2048. Validated using a containerised Docker-based testbed.
highlights: 1,807x improvement in key generation speed vs RSA-2048
Mutual authentication with replay and tamper resistance

title: Windows Malware Detection Scanner
description: Blue team cybersecurity tool that scans a Windows machine for malware indicators — suspicious processes, network connections, startup persistence, and malicious files. Integrates with VirusTotal (70+ AV engines) and the live abuse.ch malicious IP blocklist. Generates a colour-coded HTML report sorted by severity. Packaged as a standalone .exe with no Python install required.
highlights: Scans running processes for injection, suspicious paths, and malicious strings
Flags outbound connections against live abuse.ch malicious IP blocklist
Audits 6 Windows registry run keys and startup folders for persistence
Hashes suspicious files and checks against 70+ AV engines via VirusTotal API
Generates colour-coded HTML report (HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / INFO)
Packaged as standalone Windows .exe — no Python install needed on target
